The '''Mega Bomb''' is a one-time use [[Crafting#Bombs|explosive item]]. It damages certain items within its radius.  Other items are impervious to its effects.

Mega Bombs can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from the [[Dwarf]] (in [[The Mines]] and in the [[Volcano Dungeon]]) for {{Price|1600}}. They are also offered by the [[Desert Trader]], who will trade five [[Iridium Ore]] for one Mega Bomb. They can be purchased from the [[Desert Festival#Calico Egg Merchant|Calico Egg Merchant]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|15|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. [[Squid Kid]]s, [[Bats|Iridium Bats]], [[Haunted Skull]]s, and [[Magma Duggy|Magma Duggies]] may also drop a Mega Bomb when slain. Mega Bombs can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during any season.  Five Mega Bombs may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|Treasure Rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. 3-5 Mega Bombs may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] provided the player has upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] at least two times. A Bomb may occasionally be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|50}}. Five Mega Bombs may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]] or [[Golden Mystery Box]]. Six or eight Mega Bombs can be given as a prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]] in the Mayor's Manor. [[Kent]] may randomly send one in the mail as a gift.

Tip: Due to the wide blast area it is often a challenge to use the Mega Bomb without taking damage. Ensure ample healing supplies are available when using this. If a player has read the [[Dwarvish Safety Manual]], they will take 25% less damage from a Mega Bomb.

==Bundles==
Mega Bomb is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
A Mega Bomb can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt155.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring|Bomber Jacket]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a red dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a red dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
*Two Mega Bombs are requested by [[Lava Eel]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.

==Trivia==
*The [[Bouncer]] guarding the [[Casino]] will drop a Mega Bomb to ward off the player if they use glitches to try to enter the Casino without permission.
